response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.85. It is a proposal only, awaiting a human decision (case C-A-261110-0004).

**Three facts that drove it:**
1. **Algorithmic re-pricing:** All 76 orders are PEGGED children of two parent orders (P-T-X1110-04-B and P-T-X1110-04-S). Each cancel is followed within milliseconds by a re-peg on the same side. Cancel symmetry is 0.994, and the orders sit at the touch (0 ticks) at about 1.09 times average depth.
2. **The resting orders were trading:** 121 filled on the resting side, 41 of them before any opposite-side trade, so feature (a) is absent.
3. **No one-sided benefit:** The price moved 1 tick with 0 reversion, and the round trip was about 1.03 ticks with symmetric quoting. That is ordinary spread income, so feature (b) is absent. There were no market events and no risk events. The high order-to-trade ratio (30.0) and cancel ratio (0.967) come from re-pegging.

The desk's earlier closures on T-X1027-04 are a different trader, so I used them as context only. This trader has no prior alerts.

**What would change my mind:** Evidence that the quoting was really one-sided, with cancels on one side only. A favourable move that reverts after the cancel would also change it.
